title: editor::tests::the_editor_gets_the_prompt_text_in_the_file fails some runs of the full suite
body: A background agent saw `the_editor_gets_the_prompt_text_in_the_file` in `src/editor.rs` fail about one run in four of `cargo test --all-features -- --test-threads 4`, while working on coax-d1bcb7. `src/editor.rs` is unchanged since 4468c62. Run alone twelve times, the test passed every time. That points at another test running in parallel with it, perhaps one that sets `VISUAL` or `EDITOR` or shares a file. Nobody has looked further yet.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/df584c97
notes.text: Ten runs of the full suite and eight of the library tests with `-j 4 --test-threads 4` all passed, so the failure did not reproduce. The test helper `script` wrote a shell script, made it executable and ran it as the editor. That is the pattern that fails with ETXTBSY when another test thread forks while the write is still open. The helper now writes the script as plain text and passes `sh <path>` as the editor, so nothing executes a freshly written file. The tests pass. Uncommitted, and closed with the commit that carries it.
